### append { #keecas.dataframe.Dataframe.append }

`append(other, strict=True)`

Append a single row to the Dataframe.

#### Parameters

| Name     | Type                                        | Description                                                                                                                                                                      | Default    |
|----------|---------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| `other`  | 'Dataframe' \| dict\[Hashable, Any\] \| Any | Data to append as a new row. Can be:   - Dataframe: Uses first row of the other Dataframe   - Dict: Uses values from the dictionary   - Any: Uses the same value for all columns | _required_ |
| `strict` | bool                                        | If True, only considers keys that exist in self                                                                                                                                  | `True`     |

#### Note

This adds exactly one row, increasing width by 1 only if there are keys to append to.

### dict_repr { #keecas.dataframe.Dataframe.dict_repr }

`dict_repr()`

Get string representation as a regular dictionary.

### extend { #keecas.dataframe.Dataframe.extend }

`extend(other, strict=True)`

Extend the Dataframe by adding multiple rows from another source.

#### Parameters

| Name     | Type                                                | Description                                                                                                                                                                       | Default    |
|----------|-----------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| `other`  | 'Dataframe' \| dict\[Hashable, Any\] \| list\[Any\] | Data to extend with. Can be:   - Dataframe: Adds all rows from the other Dataframe   - Dict: Converts to Dataframe and extends   - List: Extends each column with the list values | _required_ |
| `strict` | bool                                                | If True, only considers keys that exist in self                                                                                                                                   | `True`     |

#### Raises

| Type       | Description                                    |
|------------|------------------------------------------------|
| ValueError | If other is not a supported type for extension |

### print_dict { #keecas.dataframe.Dataframe.print_dict }

`print_dict()`

Print the Dataframe as a regular dictionary.

### update { #keecas.dataframe.Dataframe.update }

`update(*args, **kwargs)`

Update the Dataframe with new data, extending width as needed.

Similar to dict.update() but maintains tabular structure by ensuring
all columns have consistent length after the update.

#### Parameters

| Name       | Type   | Description                                           | Default   |
|------------|--------|-------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| `*args`    | Any    | Positional arguments (expects at most one dictionary) | `()`      |
| `**kwargs` | Any    | Keyword arguments representing new column data        | `{}`      |

#### Raises

| Type      | Description                                      |
|-----------|--------------------------------------------------|
| TypeError | If more than one positional argument is provided |
